The contrast between the intensity of the day and the rest of the year can make the rest of the time feel more deliberate, as if you’re operating with a heightened awareness of your choices. ### **2. This can make the rest of the year feel more urgent—not in a stressful way, but in a way that encourages you to ask: *"How am I showing up today? Am I aligning my actions with the values I hold?"* It’s a way of carrying the spirit of the day into daily life. ### **4.
